rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=214, gs_n_gaussians=512, gs_n_iter=150, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=False, gs_outer_wall_s=1080, rationale=iter-1 baseline (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). HYPOTHESIS: R2-Gaussian is structurally FBP-bounded on dense rebinned Mayo (2304-view) AND budget-starved at 214 per-scene fits, so expect hr~0. Per-scene cost = 214 x (512 Gaussians x 150 Adam steps x one 2304-view forward proj); the 20-min budget allows only ~5.6s/scene, so gs_n_iter is held LOW (150 vs 600 default) and gs_n_gaussians MODEST (512 vs 1024 default) to maximise the number of the 214 scenes that finish. gs_outer_wall_s=1080 is the HARD in-solver wall (18 min) so the per-scene loop self-truncates before the 30-min SLURM kill, scoring whatever completed; val_n stays 214 (NOT reduced) per mandate. If <214 scenes finish, that documents R2-Gaussian budget-starvation on the 214-slice protocol (a real finding). LRs at solver defaults (one-knob discipline starts iter-2).
